install: set -e; if ! command -v uvx >/dev/null 2>&1; then curl -LsSf https://astral.sh/uv/install.sh | sh; sudo ln -sf "$HOME/.local/bin/uv" /usr/local/bin/uv; sudo ln -sf "$HOME/.local/bin/uvx" /usr/local/bin/uvx; fi; mkdir -p /tmp/google-auth; if [ -n "${GOOGLE_OAUTH_KEYS_B64:-}" ]; then echo "$GOOGLE_OAUTH_KEYS_B64" | base64 -d > /tmp/google-auth/gcp-oauth.keys.json; fi; if [ -n "${GOOGLE_OAUTH_TOKENS_B64:-}" ]; then echo "$GOOGLE_OAUTH_TOKENS_B64" | base64 -d > /tmp/google-auth/tokens.json; fi; if [ -n "${GMAIL_CREDENTIALS_B64:-}" ]; then echo "$GMAIL_CREDENTIALS_B64" | base64 -d > /tmp/google-auth/gmail-credentials.json; fi; if [ -n "${GOOGLE_CHAT_MCP_REPO:-}" ] && [ ! -d /tmp/google-chat-mcp-server ]; then git clone "$GOOGLE_CHAT_MCP_REPO" /tmp/google-chat-mcp-server; fi
